text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer argument sentences with connectives like \"In addition\" and \"For instance\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures the ability to link ideas into a more extended, coherent line of reasoning rather than listing points one by one."},{"evidence":"\"my opponents would argue\" \"when they detect my reasons\"","quality":"argumentation","description":"This captures presenting a claim alongside awareness of counterargument and response."},{"evidence":"\"eradicate some student's favorite cafeteria foods\" \"changing the menu wouldn't be necessary\"","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures developing reasons with explanation and relevance instead of only naming points."},{"evidence":"\"current food consists of fruits, vegetables and also green salad\" \"protein, Vitamin D\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"This captures using more specific evidence to back up the main claim."},{"evidence":"\"definetely\" \"In additon\" \"focuse\"","quality":"conventional accuracy","description":"This captures somewhat stronger control of spelling and standard written conventions despite remaining errors."},{"evidence":"\"their school lunch like other schools usually do\" \"unique on it's own way\"","quality":"sentence elaboration","description":"This captures the use of more elaborated sentence structures that go beyond very short, repetitive statements."}]}
